activity_summary: The children took you north past the Rother Market. Susanna kept the count at twenty houses and barns, and nobody hurt, and she kept Saturday's order. Hamnet left the nail in his pocket. Judith had the chimney and the weeds. You brought no better count.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Followed, and brought no better count.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Led north, and kept the nail pocketed.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Had the chimney and the weeds before you arrived.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the count at twenty, and at nobody hurt.

facets.activity: Went north past the Rother Market with the children

quotes.speaker: susanna_shakespeare
quotes.text: Twenty houses and barns. Nobody was hurt

quotes.speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
quotes.text: The nail stays in the pocket
